description: This file implements the 'assert' element used within the MiniLang framework of OFBiz. It defines the Assert class, which performs conditional assertions during method execution, checking specified conditions and logging errors if assertions fail.

classes.name: Assert
classes.description: Implements the <assert> element for conditional assertion checks within the MiniLang framework, evaluating specified conditions and recording failures.

methods.name: Assert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Assert object by parsing the XML element and setting up conditionals and configuration.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the assertion, checking all conditions and logging errors in the error list if any conditions fail.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Assert element, including its attributes and conditions.
